 CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJAY KUMAR DWIVEDI  ---------

For the Petitioner :Mr. Avilash Kumar, Advocate For State : Mr. Karan Shahdeo, A.C. to S.C.-II For NHAI : Mrs. Khushboo Kataruka,Advocate 04/Dated: 08/07/2024 The present writ petition has been filed for issuance of direction upon the respondent No.3 to measure the petitioner's house and the land appertaining to Khata No. 66, Plot No. 2063,
Mouza-Pipra, P.S+District-Hazaribagh, measuring an area of 0.275 Acre and to reassess the amount of compensation in lieu of acquisition of the same for widening of NH-2 vide Land Acquisition Case No. 22/2012-13.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that though the petitioner has received compensation of Rs.1,80,14,645/- under protest pursuant to Award No. 169 prepared in connection with Land Acquisition Case No. 22/2012-13, however, he has not been paid any amount for the house situated over the said land.
Moreover, the said compensation was also paid to him at the old rate.
The petitioner raised the objection before the respondent No.3 in this regard, however, no action was taken, which has compelled him to prefer the present writ petition.

3. Mrs. Khushboo Kataruka, learned counsel for the respondent-NHAI, submits that the petitioner has got statutory/efficacious remedy under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act, 1956') for redressal of his grievance.

4. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering that the petitioner has got statutory/efficacious remedy under Section 3G(5) of the Act, 1956 for ventilating his grievance,
without entering into the merit of the case, he is given liberty to prefer an application raising the objection with regard to insufficient payment of compensation to him in connection with Land Khemlal Saw vs The State Of Jharkhand on 8 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66946097/
1 Acquisition Case No. 22/2012-13 before the respondent No.3.

sentences.text:
On receipt of the said representation,
the respondent No.3 shall refer the matter to the Additional Collector, Hazaribagh-cum- Arbitrator under the provisions of Section 3G(5) of the Act, 1956 within 30 days from the date of receipt of the said application.
5. The present writ petition is accordingly disposed of with the aforesaid liberty and direction.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Satyarthi/-
